test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1): Morning Practice - Day 1
subject: general
question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 12 hours. Pipe B can empty it in X hours. If both the pipes are opened together, then the tank will be filled in 30 hours. Find X.
solution:
Let, tank capacity be 120 units

⇒ Tap A efficiency = total capacity/time taken to fill the tank

⇒ Tap A efficiency = 120 units/12hrs

So, Efficiency = 10 units/hours

But when Both A and B open together it takes 30 hours to fill the tank

Efficiency (A + B) = 120/30 = 4 units/hr

⇒ Efficiency of A + B = Efficiency of A + efficiency of B

⇒ 4 units/hr = 10 units/hr + Efficiency of B

⇒ Efficiency of B = - 6 units/hr

Time taken to empty the full tank by Tap B = 120/6 = 20hours 

**∴ The value of X is 20 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

We know, Efficiency ∝ 1/Time taken

Hence, according to question 

1/12 - 1/X = 1/30

⇒ 1/X = 1/12 - 1/30

⇒ 1/X = (5 - 2)/60

⇒ 1/X = 3/60

⇒ 1/X = 1/20

⇒ X = 20 hours

∴ The value of X is 20 hours.
